text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the central plaza with Air Groove, we heard a loud voice...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
――See you！！
I love you,mom！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove! Howdy!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what you were doing shouting at the top of your lungs...
Were you talking to your mother?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was callin' Mama to ask her
to send some snacks over!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
They don't sell them over here, you see.
Barbecue flavor carrot chips, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
W-What? You...
Isn't that being a little too spoiled?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mom tells me it's okay to lean on her, YES.
She says feeling relied on makes her happy, YES.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, Air Groove, do you ever properly pamper yourself with your mama?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mother is always busy.
As her daughter, I can't be causing her trouble.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You have to let yourself be pampered, you know!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't they worry about you every time you call?
Or send you care packages even when you didn't ask for them?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Not that there are none, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! She's worried because
Air Groove won't let her pamper her, desu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I need to go pamper them right away!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
W-What is this...
You're displaying a bizarre amount of persuasiveness.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...To begin with, I have zero experience in this.
Even if you suddenly tell me to act spoiled, what am I supposed to—
choice_data_list: Maybe try telling them you want to hear their voice?
Is there anything you want me to send you?
Is there anything you want me to send you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...To begin with, I have zero experience in this.
Even if you suddenly tell me to act spoiled, what am I supposed to—
choice_data_list: Maybe try telling them you want to hear their voice?
Is there anything you want me to send you?
Is there anything you want me to send you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My voice, you say?
Well... if it is only that much...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I think that's great! I also call my mom sometimes just because I miss hearing her voice!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nfu~. Trainer-san? OF COURSE we're going to chase after them, RIGHT?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, how should I put this...
How have you been?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Are you okay?! Did something happen?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it's really nothing at all.
I just wanted to hear your voice, is all...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Something definitely happened, didn't it?
For you to say something like that..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... that's not it!
I really just wanted to hear your voice!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A classmate told me that not relying on your mother at all
will actually make her worry even more...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Ahahahahaha!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry, sorry. Even though she's my own child,
she's just so terribly clumsy..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Well, having the thought is enough! You just go ahead and do your own thing."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I will continue to devote myself going forward.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove~!
Sooooo Cuuuute!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What was that all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Seeing Air Groove get all bashful with her mother was super cute and adorable, yes it was!
choice_data_list: Ah, you shouldn't have said that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, aah, it can't be... You lot...!?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Both of you, get over here right now! I'll knock some sense
into that rotten habit of eavesdropping!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I was harshly scolded, but for some reason,
the lecture seemed a bit shorter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come now, that's a bit much...
I am not a small child, you know.
choice_data_list: Something small should be fine, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Right, like snacks and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't lump me in with them! Sweets are—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait a second.
I just had an idea... I'll go make a call."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nfu~! Well then, let's chase after them!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Mother, do you remember
the cookies you used to make for me when I was little?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've been trying to recreate that flavor, but it hasn't been going very well...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Then, should I send you the recipe?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... rather than the recipe, I was hoping for the actual dish...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... This is so frustrating, YES!
I'm going to go check it out, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non-non! If you want to eat Mommy's cookies,
you have to say so properly!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-Taiki!? What are you—!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ahahahaha! Oh, so that's what it was!
Jeez, you really love taking the long way around!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Was that... Taiki-chan? Thank you. Please keep taking good care of my girl~"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees, leave it to meee!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on, Mother...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, look forward to the cookies!
I'll bake a whole bunch so there's enough for your friends too, so be sure to share with Taiki-chan and the others, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Do you have anything to say for yourself?
choice_data_list: I'm so glad my feelings got through!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees! All's well that ends well!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fool! That's a completely different matter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, I received a severe scolding
for eavesdropping...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, a batch of cookies was left on my desk.
Though slightly unrefined, they were warm,
comforting, and utterly delicious.
